title: Legal Forwarding Activity and the Early-Termination Charge on Contingency Placement Agreements
content:
A legal forwarding reduction applies to the early-termination charge on an agreement under the Contingency Placement Agreements where the client's legal forwarding agreement that names this contingency agreement is active. The legal forwarding agreement is the client's holding under the Legal Forwarding Agreements; its status and the suits filed under it are read from that agreement's record and its matter history.

**The reduction.** It is 40 percent where 3 or more suits were filed under that legal agreement in the 12 months before the handling date, 20 percent where it is active and 1 or 2 suits were filed in those 12 months, and nothing otherwise.

**The 12-month window.** A window of a number of months before a date covers the dates after the same day that number of months earlier, up to and including that date. A suit counts when its filing date lies in that window ending on the handling date.

**How it acts.** The reduction is a share of the early-termination charge after any proration of the fee. It is added together with any other reduction that applies to the same charge into one reduction share, and the charge after proration is reduced once by the share that results; the reductions do not act one after another.

## Desk card

| Legal forwarding agreement naming this contingency agreement | Suits filed under it in the 12 months before the handling date | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| active | 3 or more | 40 percent |
| active | 1 or 2 | 20 percent |
| active | none | nothing |
| not active (for example suspended or closed) | any number | nothing |
| none held | — | nothing |

## Hypothetical checks

- Handling date 2026-09-15. Suits filed on 2025-09-15, 2026-01-20 and 2026-06-02 under an active legal forwarding agreement naming the contingency agreement. The window covers the dates after 2025-09-15 up to and including 2026-09-15, so the suit of 2025-09-15 falls outside; 2 suits count, and the reduction is 20 percent.
- The same suits with a third filed on 2025-09-16: 3 suits count, and the reduction is 40 percent.
- 4 suits in the window but the legal forwarding agreement is suspended: nothing.
